cohort: 1,098,981 obese women (BMI > 30) with singleton live births who underwent attempted induction of labor between 37 and 44 weeks of gestation in the United States from 2012 to 2016
finding: The study developed and validated a predictive model for failed induction of labor among obese women, achieving an AUC of 0.79 on internal validation and 0.77 on external validation.
